_comment: Scripts only — the repo root is NOT a workspace and installs nothing. Deliberately no `packageManager` field: `pnpm/action-setup@v4` reads THIS file by default (`package_json_file: package.json`), and every workflow already passes `version: 10`, so declaring it here makes the action abort with 'Multiple versions of pnpm specified' and fails every CI job at setup. The pnpm pin lives in server/package.json and client/package.json, which is where corepack looks when you run pnpm inside those packages.
